prompt: Close the cumulative B2, B2.1, and B3 integration work into a reproducible merge candidate. Do not add Graph or Run capability. Establish an isolated test baseline, verify database migrations and one-database TypeScript-to-Go-to-Temporal behavior, fix only merge-delta defects, split logical commits, and attach truthful evidence.
allowed_actions: Inspect and adjust files already belonging to the B2, B2.1, and B3 Target vertical slices
Add narrowly scoped integration scripts, tests, health checks, and development documentation required for a reproducible unified stack
Run isolated PostgreSQL, Temporal, TypeScript, Go, Vitest, build, typecheck, and browser checks
Create logical local Git commits for the accumulated approved work
Create M0 delivery receipts, evidence, timeline, and an advisory review decision
forbidden_actions: Implement Graph Engine, RunWorkflow, agent execution, Submission, Review, or Acceptance
Change unrelated inherited product behavior to make the suite green
Rewrite existing migration history or immutable Target revisions
Weaken Workspace authorization, outbox leases, idempotency, or workflow replay safety
Push, merge, deploy, release, or create a ship record without separate explicit approval
validation_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/shared/src/validators/target.test.ts server/src/__tests__/target-read-model.test.ts server/src/__tests__/target-routes.test.ts server/src/__tests__/verrail-domain-api.integration.test.ts ui/src/components/NewTargetDialog.test.tsx ui/src/components/TargetList.test.tsx ui/src/pages/TargetWorkbench.test.tsx ui/src/pages/VerrailHome.test.tsx ui/src/App.test.tsx
expected_evidence: Isolated current-head and base-commit test comparison
Shared-database Target, outbox, Temporal workflow, duplicate-delivery, and restart-recovery proof
Browser smoke for main navigation and all Target Workbench routes
Logical commit list and final clean-worktree status
stop_conditions: A failing check cannot be isolated from unrelated local services or reproduced against the base commit
Closing the failure would require changing unrelated inherited behavior
Migration validation would require destructive access to the user's active database
The unified stack cannot prove that API, outbox, worker, and workflow use the same database and identity
